title: Jappeere Goonga
intro: Laamɗo doole, ganndiraaɗo hakkille mum mawɗo e jappeere mum mawnde, ina heɓa nelal sirlu ummoraade e nokku mo anndaaka. Ndee jokkondiral ngal ɓe cikkaani, ina luulndii geɗe maɓɓe e laamu maɓɓe, ina waɗa ɓe e yahdu dipolomaasi, jarriborɗo hakkillaaji maɓɓe, haa jooni ina addana ɓe ƴellitaare ruuhuyankoore luggiɗnde. Mbele aɗa waawi udditaade sifaa oo jom suudu e kewuuji bayluɗi laamu maɓɓe fof ?
clues: Miin e leñol am, eɗen ndewa naange, eɗen ndewa laabi maamiraaɓe men.
Birniwol, hoodere, ko nulaaɗo mo alaa ko waawi, addanɗo mi ɓataake ummoraade e gardiiɗo doole.
Ngam ƴeewde hakkille neldoowo oo, neldu-mi dokke tedduɗe, kono ɗe ngartiraama, nde tawnoo neldoowo oo ina jogii jawdi ɓurndi heewde e Alla.
Hade am hay yettaade to suudu neldoowo oo, jappeere am mawnde ndee, ina nawtee toon e kaawisaaji e nder 6uu6ol gite.
Nde ngar mi ndee, mi naamnaama so tawii jappeere laamu nde njippiimi ndee ko miin, njaabtiimi, ina wayi no ko kañum tan woni.
Mi naatii e saal mawɗo mo 6uu6ol ngol mi 6uuccii e 6uu6ol ndiyam, e nder oon sahaa 6uu6ol, mi 6uuccii hoore am e sara Annabi Sileymaani e Alla, joom adunaaji.

arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds." (27:44)
